chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from al-Sha'iri, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, from his father, from 'Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Nothing is removed from the clothes of the slanderer except the cloak.”

key_terms.الرِّدَاءُ: the outer cloak or upper wrapping garment
key_terms.الْقَاذِفِ: the one who makes a false accusation of unchastity

ai.seo_question: What clothing may be removed from a person punished for qadhf in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the punishment of one who commits qadhf (false accusation of unchastity). It specifies a limit in how the punishment is carried out, indicating that only the outer cloak is removed from the offender’s clothing.
